questions.question: From which state, 'Pongal' festival belongs?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Pongal festival is from Tamil Nadu. It is a four-day harvest festival celebrated in the state of Tamil Nadu, South India: 
 
• Pongal is celebrated in the month of Thai, which is January or February in the Gregorian calendar. 
 
• Pongal is a thanksgiving for a bountiful harvest and marks the end of the winter solstice and the start of spring.
 
• It is dedicated to the Sun God, Surya. 
 
• The festival is celebrated with the preparation of a sweet rice dish called Pongal, which is cooked with milk, jaggery, and cardamom.
 
• Other celebrations include bull-taming contests, a bonfire made of agricultural waste, and prayers for the family's prosperity. 
 
• The four days of Pongal are named Bhogi, Surya, Mattu, and Kaanum. 
 
• The name Pongal comes from the Tamil word Ponga, which means "to boil".

questions.question: The languages spoken in Jharkhand and parts of central India mainly belong to which of the following language family?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Austro-Asiatic family.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The languages spoken in **Jharkhand and parts of central India,** especially among tribal communities, mainly belong to the Austro-Asiatic language family.
 
• Munda languages, such as** Santali, Mundari, and Ho**, are part of this family and are widely spoken in these regions.
 
• These languages have ancient roots and are primarily spoken by indigenous and tribal populations.
 
• The Austro-Asiatic family is one of the earliest language families in India, distinct from the other dominant language families.
 
• Jharkhand is known for its** linguistic diversity**, but the Austro-Asiatic languages form a significant part of the state's cultural heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indo-European family:**

 
 
• This family includes major languages like **Hindi, Bengali, and Marathi**, but it is not predominant among the tribal communities of Jharkhand.
 
• It is the largest language family in India, but Austro-Asiatic languages are more common in central India's tribal regions.
 
 
 
• **Tibeto-Burman family:**
 
 
• This family is found in northeastern India, primarily in states like **Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, and Manipur.**
 
• It does not have significant representation in Jharkhand or central India.
 
 
 
• **Dravidian family:**
 
 
• Dravidian languages, such as **Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam,** are predominantly spoken in southern India.
 
• While some Dravidian-speaking communities exist in central India, the Austro-Asiatic family is more relevant to Jharkhand.

questions.question: Which of the following tribes does NOT live in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Maasai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maasai** is a tribe that predominantly lives in **Kenya and Tanzania**.
 
• They are known for their distinct culture, customs, and dress.
 
• Unlike the other tribes listed in the question (Gond, Santhal, Tharu), the Maasai do not have a presence in India.
 
• The Maasai people are semi-nomadic and are known for their traditional lifestyle and resistance to modern cultural influences.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gond** is one of the largest tribal groups in India, found mainly in **Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• **Santhal** is a prominent tribe in India, primarily residing in **Jharkhand, West Bengal, Bihar, and Odisha**.
 
• **Tharu** is a tribal community living in the Terai region of **Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar **in India.
 
• These tribes (Gond, Santhal, Tharu) contribute to India's rich cultural and ethnic diversity.

questions.question: Recently the Siddheshwar Temple, located in Bihar on the Barabar Hills was in the news. Which ruler had the Siddheshwar Temple constructed by artisans?
questions.solution:
**Answer:** Emperor Ashoka

**Solution:**

 
• T**he ancient Siddheshwar Temple is located in the Barabar Hills in Jehanabad district, Bihar.** These hills are famous for ancient caves and temples dedicated to Lord Shiva.
 
• The temple is associated with the great emperor Emperor Ashoka, who had inscriptions written in the Brahmi script on the temple walls, which were engraved during his reign.
 
• The Barabar Hills are historically significant, and the caves in the region, such as those in the Barabar caves, date back to the Maurya dynasty, further adding to its historical importance.
 
• This temple is located at a height of approximately 880 meters (2,887 feet) above sea level and is a significant place of worship, especially during the Shravan festival.
